CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 19, 2025

The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – May 19, 2025
  (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – May 19, 2025 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:02 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Principal Planner; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Daphne
  Madrigal, Planning Technician; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant;
  Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2025-2026:

  Nomination and election of President, Vice-President, and Secretary of the Planning
  Commission for 2025-2026, in accordance with AMC 2.24.050.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect the Director of Community Development as Secretary
  of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect Eric Garcia as Vice President of the Planning
  Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None

  05/19/2025
   Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect Chris Olson as President of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

E.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – MARCH 17, 2025 (7:06 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the March 17, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the March 17, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – JUNE 20, 2022 (7:06 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the June 20, 2022, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the June 20, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – APRIL 18, 2022 (7:06 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the April 18, 2022, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the April 18, 2022, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  MINUTES – APRIL 4, 2022 (7:06 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to

  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as

  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  05/19/2025
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, 3, and 4.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  Commissioner Gardea abstained from Item 2, Minutes – June 20,
  2022; and Item 3, Minutes – April 18, 2022.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AGENDA
  ITEMS 1 & 4:  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olson

  AGENDA

F.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  PLANNING COMMISSIONER TRAINING AND HOUSING LAW
  UPDATE (7:09 P.M.)
  • This is a report to inform the Planning Commission about their
  roles and responsibilities; the Brown Act for open meetings for
  local legislative bodies in California; and recent updates to State
  housing laws.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the item to a date uncertain.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olsen
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 6:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-69 & TENTATIVE TRACT
  MAP TTM-25-02 (7:11 P.M.)
  • 231-235 South Curtis Avenue
  • Applicant: Henry Ho
  3
  05/19/2025
   •  This is an application for a Planned Development Permit and
  Tentative Tract Map to allow for the demolition of two (2) existing
  single-family residences and the construction of a 10-unit
  condominium complex, located at 231-235 South Curtis Avenue
  within the RH (Residential High Density) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-03, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-23-69 and Tentative Tract Map
  TTM-25-02, to allow for the demolition of two (2) existing single-
  family residences and the construction of a 10-unit condominium
  complex, located at 231-235 South Curtis Avenue within the RH
  (Residential High Density) zone, and finding Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-69 and Tentative Tract Map TTM-25-
  02 to be exempt from review under the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15332, Class 32 of Title
  14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from
  CEQA review projects characterized as in-fill development.
  •  Senior Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and continued.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Henry Ho
  2.) Kelvin Lin
  3.) Vincent Tsoi
  4.) Marie Lopez

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the item to the July 21, 2025 Planning Commission
  meeting.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia.
  •  Motion withdrawn.

  RECESS:
  •  Moved for a 10-minute recess.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  Recess at 7:18 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 7:35 P.M.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue to a date uncertain.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Majority Voice Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Garcia, Olsen
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Chen, Juarez, Mojarro

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.
  4
  05/19/2025
 I.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  Vice President Garcia commented that he’s heard talk in the community about
  the In-N-Out project at 1210 N. Atlantic Blvd., and its relocation of the entrance to
  Stoneman Drive. He asked staff to direct the public to more information about the
  project. (8:46 P.M.)

J.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley introduced Daphne Madrigal as the new
  Planning Technician. (8:47 P.M.)
  •  Planning Technician Daphne Madrigal thanked the Commission for the
  opportunity and expressed she is looking forward to working with the community
  and serving the people. (8:47 P.M.)
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided an update on the Objective Design
  Standards and Design Guidelines project status and timeline. She also provided
  an update on the Historic Preservation Ordinance, which is scheduled to come to
  the Planning Commission in July. Regarding the In-N-Out, information and details
  on the project is available on the City’s “Development Projects” webpage. (8:48
  P.M.)

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:52 P.M. to Monday,
  June 16, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.
